text:
liz: heads up — CS flagged missing pages for a production alert. looks like incbot suppressed notifications between 03:20-03:45 UTC, several customers affected.
incbot: AUTOMATION: suppressed 12 pages due to rule 'quiet_window_v2' matching timezone window. payload:
```json
{"alert_id":"a-8f3d","suppressed_count":12,"rule":"quiet_window_v2"}
```
josh: that was my canary change from ~03:17 — i tweaked the regex to include a midnight alias, maybe overbroad.
ops-bot: Deployment 2026-03-18T03:17Z by josh -> service=pagerbridge, change=quiet_window_regex_update, status=SUCCESS
sre-oncall: ack. i'm taking lead. paging manually now and disabling suppressor flag.
paul: created PD incident PD-2345 and sent manual SMS to oncall rota. link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-2345
maria: CS update — 3 customers (cust-A, cust-B, cust-C) filed tickets about missed notifications; one escalated to SLA-owner. collecting customer timestamps and examples.
sre-oncall: command I ran to disable the flag:
```
curl -X POST 'https://ops/api/flags/quiet_window_v2/disable' -H 'Authorization: Bearer [redacted]'
```
ops-bot: feature-flag quiet_window_v2 disabled (propagated to ap-south, eu-west, us-east) — completed in 22s
sre-oncall: manual pages sent, PD acknowledged, teams responding. monitoring for suppressed pages spike for 15m.
liz: quick timeline: deploy (03:17) -> suppressor match (03:20+) -> CS tickets (03:30) -> flag disable (03:40). rollback + manual paging mitigated most customer impact. opening postmortem; owner = liz.
josh: sorry folks — missed timezone/DST edge-case in unit tests. will add e2e and pair with qa tomorrow.
maria: i'll notify support/SAMs for affected customers and attach PD-2345 + logs. please add suggested customer remediation text.
paul: tagging incident: root_cause=suppressor-regex, mitigation=flag-disable, mitigation_owner=sre-oncall, postmortem_owner=liz
sre-oncall: short-term followups: 1) add alert "suppressed_pages > 5 in 5m" that triggers loud page, 2) circuit-breaker to auto-send manual page if suppression rate high, 3) backfill tests for timezone logic.
liz: agree. also add a change-review checklist item for suppressor/quiet-window modifications. will post summary to #all-hands and update oncall playbook. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Ticket INC-9876 created in ops-tracker for followups (owner=liz)
liz: closing note: will keep thread open until PD-2345 resolved and no new suppressed pages for 30m. thanks everyone for fast mitigation.
